articles.title: How food shortages reshaped India's agricultural policy
articles.description: In the mid-1960s, domestic foodgrain production was insufficient to meet demand. India depended heavily on imported grain. Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri spearheaded self-reliance and irrigation expansion.

articles.title: Kesavananda Bharati and the Basic Structure Doctrine
articles.description: In 1973, a 13-judge constitutional bench ruled that Parliament cannot alter the basic structure of the Constitution. The landmark verdict protected fundamental rights and judicial independence.

articles.title: 1991 Balance of Payments crisis and LPG reforms
articles.description: With foreign exchange reserves down to barely two weeks of imports, India airlifted gold reserves to London. PV Narasimha Rao and Manmohan Singh dismantled the License Raj, ushering in globalization.

articles.title: Aryabhata launch: India's first foray into space
articles.description: Built in humble sheds in Peenya and transported by bullock cart, Aryabhata was launched in 1975 aboard a Soviet Kosmos-3M rocket, establishing ISRO's legendary technological capability.

articles.title: 1971 Liberation War and the Shimla Agreement
articles.description: The Indian Armed Forces liberated Bangladesh in a lightning 13-day war resulting in the unconditional surrender of 93,000 Pakistani soldiers, redrawing the geopolitical map of South Asia.

articles.title: Project Tiger: Launching India's flagship conservation drive
articles.description: Faced with dwindling wild tiger numbers under 2,000 in 1973, Jim Corbett National Park hosted the launch of Project Tiger, creating dedicated tiger reserves that today protect over 75 percent of wild tigers.

articles.title: Chipko Movement: When women hugged trees to save forests
articles.description: In Mandal village of Chamoli, Gaura Devi and rural women encircled ash trees to block commercial loggers, birthing an eco-feminist movement that transformed forest conservation policy in India.

articles.title: Interstate river water disputes and Article 262
articles.description: Water sharing across the Cauvery, Krishna, and Sutlej has tested federal cohesion for decades. Article 262 empowers Parliament to adjudicate disputes, barring the Supreme Court from direct jurisdiction.

articles.title: Operation Flood: Dr. Verghese Kurien and the White Revolution
articles.description: Through the Anand cooperative model and NDDB, Operation Flood turned a milk-deficient nation into the world's largest milk producer, empowering millions of rural women dairy farmers.

articles.title: Indus Waters Treaty: Surviving six decades of conflict
articles.description: Signed in 1960 under World Bank mediation, the pact divided the Indus river system, allocating eastern rivers to India and western rivers to Pakistan, remaining intact despite multiple wars.

articles.title: Pokhran-I: India's peaceful nuclear explosion
articles.description: On Buddha Purnima in 1974, scientists led by Raja Ramanna detonated India's first nuclear device beneath Thar Desert sands, signaling strategic deterrence under the codename Operation Smiling Buddha.

articles.title: Chandrayaan-3: Conquering the lunar south pole
articles.description: The Vikram lander touched down softly near the Moon's rugged south pole at Shiv Shakti point, making India the fourth country to land on the Moon and the first near the south polar crater zone.

articles.title: Homi Bhabha and India's three-stage nuclear power program
articles.description: Capitalizing on vast domestic thorium reserves, Dr. Homi Bhabha designed a closed three-stage fuel cycle transitioning from pressurized heavy water reactors to fast breeder and advanced thorium reactors.

articles.title: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam and the Integrated Guided Missile Program
articles.description: Conceived in 1983, the IGMDP yielded five indigenous missile platforms: Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Akash, and Nag, cementing strategic defense autonomy and earning Dr. Kalam the title Missile Man of India.

articles.title: Operation Cactus: Paratroopers thwart Maldives coup
articles.description: In November 1988, responding to President Gayoom's SOS, Indian paratroopers flew 2,000 km non-stop, landed under fire in Malé, and neutralized foreign mercenaries within hours, securing regional stability.

articles.title: The 1975 Emergency and the assault on democratic institutions
articles.description: Under Article 352, civil liberties and press freedoms were suspended for 21 months. Fundamental rights were curtailed until the 1977 elections restored constitutional democracy.

articles.title: 44th Constitutional Amendment: Erecting guardrails against dictatorship
articles.description: Enacted in 1978, the 44th Amendment replaced internal disturbance with armed rebellion, mandated Cabinet written advice for Emergency, and ensured Articles 20 and 21 can never be suspended.
articles.source: Ministry of Law & Justice / UPSC GS2

articles.title: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and the integration of 565 princely states
articles.description: Armed with persuasion, diplomacy, and resolute firmness, Sardar Patel and VP Menon integrated hundreds of autonomous kingdoms into the Indian Union, preserving territorial integrity.

articles.title: The 1978 currency demonetisation of high-denomination notes
articles.description: The Janata Party government demonetised 1,000, 5,000, and 10,000 rupee notes via ordinance to combat illicit wealth, an early precursor to economic anti-black-money measures.

articles.title: Operation Vijay 1961: Ending 451 years of Portuguese colonial rule
articles.description: Indian tri-service forces marched into Goa, Daman, and Diu in December 1961 after Portugal refused diplomatic negotiations, liberating the enclave and reuniting it with the motherland.

articles.title: Birsa Munda and the Great Ulgulan tribal rebellion
articles.description: In the Chhotanagpur plateau, Bhagwan Birsa Munda rallied Munda tribes against British land alienation and moneylenders, forcing the colonial state to pass the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act 1908.

articles.title: Dr. BR Ambedkar and the 1927 Mahad Satyagraha
articles.description: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar led thousands of Dalits to drink water from the Chawdar tank in Mahad, declaring equal human rights and igniting the modern civil rights battle against social untouchability.

articles.title: The Indigo Revolt: Bengal ryots defy British planters
articles.description: Exploited by fraudulent contracts, Bengal peasants united to refuse sowing indigo, supported by Dinabandhu Mitra's play Nil Darpan, forcing the colonial government to establish the Indigo Commission.

articles.title: Save Silent Valley: The battle for Kerala's virgin rainforest
articles.description: Poets, teachers, and conservationists resisted a hydroelectric dam across Kunthipuzha river to protect endangered lion-tailed macaques, leading to the creation of Silent Valley National Park in 1984.

articles.title: The Right to Information Act: Empowering citizen oversight
articles.description: Born from Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan grassroots public hearings in rural Rajasthan, the RTI Act 2005 dismantled official secrecy, empowering citizens to audit governance directly.

articles.title: 1969 Bank Nationalisation: Redirecting credit to rural India
articles.description: Prime Minister Indira Gandhi nationalised 14 major private commercial banks holding 70 percent of deposits, expanding banking into unbanked villages, agriculture, and small-scale industries.

articles.title: Golden Quadrilateral: The highway network that united India
articles.description: Initiated under Atal Bihari Vajpayee, the 5,846-km four-lane expressway connected Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata, cutting transit times and sparking national freight and industrial corridors.

articles.title: UPI and the India Stack: Building global digital infrastructure
articles.description: Unified Payments Interface developed by NPCI revolutionized fintech, processing over 14 billion monthly transactions and exporting open-protocol digital payments across four continents.

articles.title: The 1944 Bombay Plan: Industrialists proposing state-led growth
articles.description: Eight prominent industrialists, including JRD Tata and GD Birla, authored a plan advocating massive state investment in heavy industry and infrastructure, laying early seeds of five-year plans.

articles.title: Chabahar Port: India's gateway bypassing land barriers
articles.description: India's strategic long-term agreement on Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar unlocks sea-rail trade corridors connecting Mumbai to landlocked Afghanistan, Iran, and Central Asia via INSTC.

articles.title: Operation Vijay 1999: Recapturing the heights of Kargil
articles.description: Braving sheer vertical cliffs and sub-zero temperatures, Indian troops and Mirage-2000 air strikes evicted entrenched Pakistani regular intruders from Tololing, Tiger Hill, and Point 4875.

articles.title: Operation Meghdoot: Securing Siachen at 20,000 feet
articles.description: In April 1984, the Kumaon Regiment executed pre-emptive heliborne landings on Bilafond La and Sia La, securing the 76-km Siachen Glacier and dominating Saltoro Ridge ever since.

articles.title: Non-Aligned Movement: India's Cold War diplomatic autonomy
articles.description: At Bandung and Belgrade, Jawaharlal Nehru joined Tito, Nasser, and Sukarno to forge NAM, rejecting superpower military alliances and championing decolonization and sovereign equality.

articles.title: Project 75I: Securing underwater deterrence in the Indian Ocean
articles.description: Developing six advanced conventional submarines with Air Independent Propulsion (AIP) enables weeks of silent submerged patrols, safeguarding vital sea lines of communication.

articles.title: The Quad and Exercise Malabar: Indo-Pacific maritime balance
articles.description: Comprising India, the US, Japan, and Australia, the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue coordinates high-end naval exercises, undersea domain awareness, and maritime supply chain security.

articles.title: Target Zero: How India eradicated smallpox in 1977
articles.description: Deploying 150,000 health workers in relentless house-to-house surveillance and ring vaccination, India overcame centuries of smallpox scourge, officially certified disease-free in 1977.

articles.title: Pulse Polio Programme: Delivering two drops of hope
articles.description: Launched in 1995, nationwide National Immunization Days vaccinated 170 million children simultaneously, driving wild poliovirus transmission to zero and earning WHO certification in 2014.

articles.title: India's pharmaceutical powerhouse: From generic drugs to Vaccine Maitri
articles.description: Accounting for 20 percent of global generic medicine exports and 60 percent of global vaccine supplies, Indian manufacturers supplied life-saving doses to over 100 developing nations.

articles.title: The 1943 Bengal Famine: Wartime policy and starvation
articles.description: Denial policies, war inflation, and grain export priorities under colonial administration caused an estimated 3 million deaths, shaping India's post-independence obsession with food sovereignty.

articles.title: Justice KS Puttaswamy: Declaring privacy a fundamental right
articles.description: A unanimous nine-judge Supreme Court bench declared the right to privacy an intrinsic part of the right to life and personal liberty under Article 21, establishing boundaries for state surveillance.

articles.title: Bhadla Solar Park: Harvesting clean energy in the desert
articles.description: Spanning 14,000 acres in Rajasthan's Thar desert, Bhadla produces 2,245 MW of solar power, embodying India's pledge to install 500 GW of non-fossil electrical capacity by 2030.

articles.title: Project Cheetah: Returning the world's fastest cat to India
articles.description: Declared extinct in India in 1952, African cheetahs translocated from Namibia and South Africa to Kuno National Park represent the world's first intercontinental large carnivore reintroduction.

articles.title: Mission Gaganyaan: India's voyage to send astronauts to orbit
articles.description: ISRO's human-rated LVM3 rocket will carry Indian vyomanauts to a 400-km low Earth orbit for three days before a precision parachute splashdown in Arabian Sea waters.

articles.title: 1921 Discovery of Harappa: Unearthing 5,000 years of urban planning
articles.description: Excavations by Daya Ram Sahni and Rakhaldas Banerjee pushed Indian antiquity back two millennia, revealing grid street planning, subterranean drainage, and vast granaries.

articles.title: Doklam Standoff 2017: Standing resolute at the trijunction
articles.description: For 73 days, Indian and Chinese soldiers maintained eyeball-to-eyeball standoff on the Doklam plateau, stopping unauthorized road construction near the vulnerable Siliguri Corridor.

articles.title: TN Seshan: The Chief Election Commissioner who curbed electoral malpractices
articles.description: Enforcing the Model Code of Conduct, voter ID cards, and strict campaign expenditure limits, TN Seshan ended rampant booth capturing and established the Election Commission's fierce autonomy.

articles.title: Rani Gaidinliu: The spiritual leader who resisted British rule
articles.description: Leading the Heraka movement at age 16 in Manipur and Nagaland, Gaidinliu resisted British taxation and missionary dominance, spending 14 years imprisoned until Independence in 1947.

articles.title: 73rd and 74th Amendments: Decentralizing power to local self-governments
articles.description: Passed in 1992, the amendments gave constitutional status to Panchayats and Municipalities, reserving one-third of seats for women and institutionalizing grassroots democracy.
articles.source: Ministry of Panchayati Raj / UPSC GS2

articles.title: Dr. MS Swaminathan and the Green Revolution in India
articles.description: Introducing semi-dwarf high-yielding Mexican wheat varieties in Punjab and Haryana, agricultural scientist MS Swaminathan turned India from a ship-to-mouth nation into a food-surplus grain exporter.

articles.title: Pokhran-II 1998: Operation Shakti and enduring global sanctions
articles.description: Under Atal Bihari Vajpayee, India conducted five underground nuclear tests in May 1998, weathering US economic sanctions to establish credible minimum nuclear deterrence and No First Use doctrine.

articles.title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's Maratha Military Forts & UNESCO World Heritage
articles.description: Showcasing guerilla warfare geography across the Sahyadri ranges, 12 forts including Raigad and Shivneri reflect advanced hill-fortification and naval defense strategies.

articles.title: Delimitation Commission and Article 82: Population vs Representation Debate
articles.description: Delimitation redraws parliamentary constituency boundaries based on the latest census. Freezing seats until the post-2026 census addresses federal balance between growing and family-planning states.
articles.source: Election Commission of India / Law Ministry / GS2

articles.title: PM-MITRA Mega Textile Parks: Integrated World-Class Supply Chains
articles.description: Setting up 7 plug-and-play textile mega parks with world-class logistics to boost FDI, scale value-addition from farm to fashion, and rival global manufacturing hubs.

articles.title: Project Great Indian Bustard: Supreme Court Right to Clean Climate Landmark
articles.description: In MK Ranjitsinh v. Union of India, the Supreme Court recognized the constitutional right to be free from adverse climate impacts while balancing renewable energy lines with GIB protection.
articles.source: Supreme Court of India / MoEFCC / GS3

articles.title: Ethical Dilemmas in Automated Law Enforcement and Facial Recognition
articles.description: Balancing algorithmic predictive policing against privacy, false-positive biases on marginalized groups, and the lack of algorithmic accountability under administrative law.
articles.source: DoPT / NITI Aayog Case Study / GS4

articles.title: Dholavira Water Management: Ancient Harappan Hydraulic Engineering
articles.description: Excavations in the Rann of Kutch reveal a sophisticated cascade of stepped reservoirs, bunds, and storm-water drains, proving arid-zone urban resilience in 2500 BCE.
articles.source: Archaeological Survey of India / UNESCO / GS1

articles.title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS): Reforming Colonial Criminal Jurisprudence
articles.description: Replacing the 1860 Indian Penal Code, BNS introduces community service punishments, precise terrorism definitions, electronic evidence admissibility, and gender-neutral cruelty provisions.
articles.source: Ministry of Home Affairs / Official Gazette / GS2

articles.title: India Semiconductor Mission: Silicon Fabs and ATMP Packaging in Dholera
articles.description: With ₹76,000 crore incentive framework, ISM anchors domestic semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT testing, and chip design to eliminate critical supply chain vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Samudrayaan & Deep Ocean Mission: Matsya 6000 Submersible Exploration
articles.description: Indigenous crewed submersible Matsya 6000 explores 6,000-meter deep seabed for polymetallic nodules, cobalt crusts, and benthic biodiversity, advancing India's Blue Economy.
articles.source: Ministry of Earth Sciences / NIOT / GS3

articles.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEEC): Maritime-Rail Pivot
articles.description: Launched at the G20 New Delhi Summit, IMEEC integrates ship-to-rail transit networks connecting India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Israel, and Europe as a sustainable trade artery.
articles.source: Ministry of External Affairs / G20 Secretariat / GS2

articles.title: Birsa Munda and the Ulgulan: Tribal Resistance and Land Autonomy
articles.description: Birsa Munda's 1899-1900 rebellion against British colonial exploitation and the Thikadars led to the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act 1908, safeguarding Adivasi land rights.
articles.source: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / National Archives / GS1

articles.title: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023: Privacy Architecture
articles.description: Enshrining the Puttaswamy privacy doctrine, the Act establishes Data Fiduciaries, Data Protection Board, consent requirements, and heavy penalties for unauthorized data breaches.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: SIGHT Programme and Electrolyser Manufacturing
articles.description: Aiming for 5 MMT annual green hydrogen production by 2030, the SIGHT scheme provides financial incentives to localize electrolyser fabrication and decarbonize refineries and fertilizer units.

articles.title: Cheetah Reintroduction in Kuno National Park: Inter-Continental Translocation
articles.description: The world's first inter-continental large-carnivore translocation from Namibia and South Africa aims to restore India's degraded savannah and open-forest grassland ecosystems.
articles.source: National Tiger Conservation Authority / MoEFCC / GS3

articles.title: Whistleblower Protection and Corporate Ethics: Lessons from Regulatory Scrutiny
articles.description: Examining statutory protections under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act and SEBI LODR regulations to shield internal whistleblowers exposing systemic accounting irregularities.

articles.title: Bhakti Movement and Sant Kabir: Syncretic Socio-Religious Reformation
articles.description: Rejecting ritualism and caste hierarchies through vernacular dohas, Sant Kabir pioneered nirguna bhakti, inspiring egalitarian social unity across medieval India.
articles.source: Ministry of Culture / Sahitya Akademi / GS1

articles.title: Supreme Court Constitution Bench Verdict on Article 370 Abrogation
articles.description: Upholding the constitutional validity of CO 272 and 273, the 5-judge bench reaffirmed asymmetric federalism boundaries while directing restoration of statehood and assembly elections.

articles.title: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan: Integrated Multimodal Planning
articles.description: A GIS-based digital platform breaking departmental silos across 16 ministries, synchronizing road, rail, air, and water connectivity projects to slash logistics costs from 14% to 8% of GDP.

articles.title: MISHTI Scheme: Mangrove Conservation for Shoreline Climate Resilience
articles.description: Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes coordinates CAMPA and MGNREGS funds to plant mangroves across 540 sq km of coastline, blunting storm surges.

articles.title: Operation Kaveri: Humanitarian Evacuation from Civil Conflict Zones
articles.description: Coordinating Indian Navy stealth frigates and IAF C-130J transport aircraft, India successfully evacuated over 3,800 citizens and foreign nationals from crisis-hit Sudan.
articles.source: Ministry of External Affairs / Indian Navy / GS3

articles.title: Temple Architecture Styles: Nagara, Dravida, and Vesara Evolution
articles.description: From the curved shikhara and cruciform ground plan of Nagara to the pyramidal vimana and majestic gopurams of Dravida, architectural canons reflected regional sacred geometry.

articles.title: Inter-State River Water Disputes: Article 262 and Tribunal Stalemates
articles.description: Examining the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act 1956 and Cauvery/Krishna disputes, highlighting the necessity of a single permanent tribunal with institutional data monitoring.
articles.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Law Commission / GS2

articles.title: UPI Global Linkages: Internationalization of India's Digital Public Infrastructure
articles.description: Linking NPCI's UPI with Singapore's PayNow, UAE's Jaywan, and France's Lyra enables real-time cross-border remittances, lowering fees and dedollarizing bilateral micro-payments.
articles.source: Reserve Bank of India / NPCI / GS3

articles.title: Aditya-L1 Solar Mission: Heliophysics Research at Lagrange Point L1
articles.description: Stationed 1.5 million km from Earth in a halo orbit around L1, Aditya-L1 continuously tracks coronal mass ejections, solar flares, and space weather without eclipse disruptions.

articles.title: Compassion in Civil Administration: District Collector Grievance Redressal
articles.description: Case study analyzing how administrative empathy transformed grievance redressal in aspirational districts through door-step pensions and disability certification drives.

articles.title: Indian Monsoon Dynamics: El Niño, La Niña, and the Indian Ocean Dipole
articles.description: Analyzing teleconnections between equatorial Pacific sea-surface temperatures and summer monsoons, and how positive IOD events buffer India against El Niño rain deficits.

articles.title: Supreme Court Struck Down Electoral Bonds: Landmark Transparency Verdict
articles.description: A unanimous 5-judge bench held anonymous electoral bonds unconstitutional under Article 19(1)(a), establishing voters' fundamental right to information regarding political donor funding.

articles.title: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Schemes: Driving Scale Across 14 Sectors
articles.description: Targeting electronics, pharma, green mobility, and specialty steel, PLI schemes tie budgetary outlays of ₹1.97 lakh crore to incremental domestic sales, creating global export leaders.

articles.title: Great Nicobar Island Infrastructure Project: Strategic vs Ecological Balance
articles.description: The ₹72,000 crore holistic development of Galathea Bay involves a transshipment port, airstrip, and power plant, requiring compensatory afforestation and tribal Shompen safeguards.

articles.title: Voice of Global South Summit: Championing Inclusivity in Multilateral Fora
articles.description: Convening over 120 developing nations, India amplified Global South priorities on climate finance, debt restructuring, food security, and inclusion of the African Union into G20.

articles.title: Deccan Riots of 1875: Moneylender Exploitation and Agricultural Debt
articles.description: Triggered by oppressive colonial Ryotwari land revenue and usurious moneylender debt, peasant uprisings in Pune and Ahmednagar led to the Deccan Agriculturists' Relief Act 1879.

articles.title: Simultaneous Elections: Kovind Committee Recommendations on One Nation One Poll
articles.description: Proposing synchronization of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies followed by local body elections within 100 days, analyzing implications on federalism and constitutional amendments.
articles.source: High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections / GS2

articles.title: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) 2016: Resolving Stressed Assets
articles.description: Shifting control from debtor-in-possession to creditor-in-control, the IBC resolved over ₹3.4 lakh crore in bad debt, establishing the NCLT and maximizing corporate enterprise value.
articles.source: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India / GS3

articles.title: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP): Multi-City Air Quality Targets
articles.description: Covering 131 non-attainment cities, NCAP mandates 40% reduction in PM10 and PM2.5 concentrations by 2026 through vehicular transition, mechanized sweeping, and industrial monitors.
articles.source: Central Pollution Control Board / MoEFCC / GS3

articles.title: INS Vikrant: Indigenous Aircraft Carrier Commissioning and Naval Power
articles.description: Built with 76% indigenous content by Cochin Shipyard, the 45,000-tonne carrier features ski-jump STOBAR operations, anchoring carrier battle group dominance in the Indian Ocean.
articles.source: Indian Navy / Ministry of Defence / GS3

articles.title: Traditional Rainwater Harvesting: Baolis, Johads, and Zing Systems
articles.description: From Gujarat's stepwells and Rajasthan's earthen johads to Ladakh's glacial-melt zings, traditional indigenous water systems embody community-led climate adaptation.
articles.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti / INTACH / GS1

articles.title: Tribunalisation of Justice: Judicial Independence and Article 323A/B
articles.description: Examining L. Chandra Kumar and Madras Bar Association rulings, affirming that tribunals cannot bypass High Court judicial review and must maintain executive independence.
articles.source: Supreme Court Records / Law Ministry / GS2

articles.title: Agri-Stack & Digital Public Infrastructure for Indian Farmers
articles.description: Creating a foundational digital registry of farmers, geo-referenced land parcels, and crop-sown data to automate targeted crop insurance, credit disbursement, and MSP procurement.

articles.title: Gaganyaan Programme: India's Indigenous Human Spaceflight Capability
articles.description: Carrying a 3-member crew to a 400 km low-Earth orbit for 3 days, Gaganyaan qualifies India's human-rated LVM3 launch vehicle, environmental life support, and crew escape systems.

articles.title: Nolan Principles of Public Life: Selflessness and Integrity in Public Service
articles.description: Evaluating how the 7 Nolan principles—selflessness, integrity, objectivity, accountability, openness, honesty, and leadership—govern public officials facing corrupt executive pressures.
articles.source: Second Administrative Reforms Commission / DoPT / GS4

articles.title: Women in Indian Freedom Struggle: Matangini Hazra and Aruna Asaf Ali
articles.description: Highlighting the fearless leadership of 73-year-old Matangini Hazra during Quit India in Tamluk and Aruna Asaf Ali hoisting the Tricolour at Gowalia Tank Maidan.
articles.source: National Archives of India / Ministry of Culture / GS1

articles.title: Governor's Discretionary Powers under Article 200 and Bill Assent Deadlocks
articles.description: The Supreme Court clarified that Governors cannot sit indefinitely on bills passed by elected state legislatures, reiterating constitutional conventions in Punjab and Tamil Nadu cases.
articles.source: Supreme Court Records / Law Ministry / GS2

articles.title: Central Bank Digital Currency (e-Rupee): Retail and Wholesale Pilots
articles.description: The RBI's digital sovereign rupee operates without commercial bank intermediary risk, slashing currency printing costs, enabling programmable subsidies, and cross-border settlement.
articles.source: Reserve Bank of India Bulletin / GS3

articles.title: Namami Gange Mission: Aviral and Nirmal Dhara River Rejuvenation
articles.description: Integrating 400+ sewage treatment plants, industrial effluent monitoring, ghat beautification, and river dolphin conservation across the 2,525 km Ganga basin.
articles.source: National Mission for Clean Ganga / Jal Shakti / GS3

articles.title: India-EFTA Trade & Economic Partnership: $100 Billion Investment Commitment
articles.description: Signing with Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein, India secured a binding $100B investment over 15 years in exchange for tariff concessions on non-agricultural machinery.
articles.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / GS2

articles.title: Western Ghats: Biodiversity Hotspot, Endemism, and Ecological Fragility
articles.description: Older than the Himalayas, the Sahyadri range influences Indian monsoon weather and shelters over 5,000 flowering plant species, requiring Kasturirangan report conservation zones.
articles.source: Botanical Survey of India / MoEFCC / GS1

articles.title: NITI Aayog National Multidimensional Poverty Index: Dramatic Poverty Decline
articles.description: Analyzing multidimensional deprivations across health, education, and living standards, India lifted 24.8 crore people out of multidimensional poverty in 9 years.

articles.title: National Quantum Mission: Quantum Computing and Secure Communications
articles.description: With ₹6,003 crore funding, NQM develops 50-1000 qubit quantum computers, satellite-based quantum key distribution (QKD), and ultrasensitive quantum magnetometers.
articles.source: Department of Science and Technology / PIB / GS3

articles.title: India's 500 GW Non-Fossil Energy Target by 2030: The Green Energy Transition
articles.description: Rapidly scaling solar parks, ultra-mega wind corridors, and green energy open-access rules to fulfill COP26 Panchamrit pledges and decarbonize heavy industry.

articles.title: Development vs Displacement: Ethical Matrix in Tribal Rehabilitation
articles.description: Examining ethical obligations under PESA and FRA 2006 to ensure free, prior, and informed consent for Adivasi communities displaced by mega-irrigation and coal mining projects.
articles.source: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / Ethics Case Study / GS4

articles.title: Classical Languages of India: Antiquity Criteria and Cultural Heritage
articles.description: With the inclusion of Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali alongside Sanskrit and Tamil, classical status honors high antiquity and distinct literary traditions.
articles.source: Ministry of Culture / Sahitya Akademi / GS1

articles.title: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam: 106th Constitutional Amendment Act
articles.description: Mandating 33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for 15 years, operationalized post-census delimitation to bridge gender political representation gaps.
articles.source: Ministry of Law and Justice / Gazette / GS2

articles.title: PM KISAN Direct Benefit Transfer: Liquidity Support for Smallholders
articles.description: Transferring ₹6,000 annually in three equal tranches directly to 11+ crore farmers' Aadhaar-linked accounts, PM KISAN provides timely liquidity for seeds, fertilizers, and inputs.

articles.title: National Mission on Biodiversity and Human Well-Being
articles.description: Integrating biodiversity science with public health, agricultural resilience, and rural bio-economies to conserve agro-biodiversity and combat zoonotic disease spillovers.

articles.title: Project 75I: Advanced Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP) Submarines
articles.description: Equipping diesel-electric submarines with fuel-cell Air-Independent Propulsion extends submerged endurance from days to weeks, countering naval threats across the Malacca Strait.
articles.source: Indian Navy / Ministry of Defence / GS3

articles.title: Ashokan Edicts: Moral Governance, Dhamma, and Ancient Inscriptions
articles.description: Carved on rock faces and polished monolithic pillars in Prakrit, Greek, and Aramaic, Ashoka's edicts renounced aggressive warfare in favor of non-violence and public welfare.

articles.title: Right to Education (RTE) Act: Section 12(1)(c) and EWS Mandates
articles.description: Mandating 25% quota for disadvantaged children in private non-minority schools, examining fee-reimbursement delays and learning outcome disparities across states.

articles.title: Bharat 6G Vision: Terahertz Waves and Indigenous Telecom Patents
articles.description: Setting up the Bharat 6G Alliance, India aims to shape international 6G standards, terahertz wireless, and intelligent network architecture, avoiding foreign tech dependencies.

articles.title: Ramsar Wetlands of India: Expansion to 85+ Sites of International Importance
articles.description: Conserving fragile hydrological sponges from Tamil Nadu's bird sanctuaries to Ladakh's high-altitude Tso Kar, Ramsar designation enforces eco-sensitive buffer protections.

articles.title: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO): Strategic Autonomy in Eurasia
articles.description: Balancing counter-terrorism cooperation under RATS with regional connectivity and security dialogue, maintaining independent diplomatic equilibrium across Eurasian powers.
articles.source: Ministry of External Affairs / SCO / GS2

articles.title: Chola Bronzes: Nataraja Cosmic Dance and Cire-Perdue Casting
articles.description: The lost-wax casting technique under the Chola dynasty produced the iconic Nataraja, symbolizing the cosmic cycle of creation (srishti) and dissolution (samhara).
articles.source: National Museum / Tamil Nadu Archaeology / GS1

articles.title: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC): Anti-Corruption Architecture
articles.description: Created on the Santhanam Committee recommendations, the CVC exercises statutory superintendence over the CBI for corruption probes involving central government servants.

articles.title: National Logistics Policy (NLP) & Unified Logistics Interface Platform
articles.description: Integrating 30+ logistics systems across customs, railways, and ports, ULIP provides real-time container tracking, eliminating paper clearance bottlenecks and demurrage.

articles.title: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF) Early Warning Systems in the Himalayas
articles.description: Deploying automated weather stations and lake-level sensors at South Lhonak and vulnerable moraine-dammed lakes to alert downstream hydropower dams and valley settlements.
articles.source: National Disaster Management Authority / NDMA / GS3

articles.title: Conflict of Interest in Regulatory Watchdogs: SEBI and RBI Guidelines
articles.description: Case study analyzing how statutory disclosure, recusal protocols, and blind trusts prevent personal pecuniary interests from compromising securities market oversight.
articles.source: Securities and Exchange Board of India / GS4

articles.title: Geographical Indications (GI) Registry: Protecting Indigenous Artisanship
articles.description: From Kashmir Pashmina and Pochampally Ikat to Darjeeling Tea, GI tags safeguard intellectual property, preserve artisan livelihoods, and prevent substandard counterfeit exports.

articles.title: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) and Paris Principles Compliance
articles.description: Evaluating NHRC powers under the Protection of Human Rights Act 1993, prison reform visits, custodial death investigations, and international accreditation criteria.
articles.source: National Human Rights Commission / MHA / GS2

articles.title: IndiaAI Mission: Sovereign GPU Infrastructure and Foundational Models
articles.description: Investing ₹10,372 crore to build a public computing grid of 10,000+ GPUs, train multi-lingual foundational models, and finance AI startups targeting healthcare and agriculture.

articles.title: Project Tiger at 50: Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) of Reserves
articles.description: Marking 50 years of Project Tiger, scientific camera-trapping census recorded 3,682+ tigers (75% of global wild tigers), highlighting critical interstate corridor protection.
articles.source: National Tiger Conservation Authority / WII / GS3

articles.title: The Quad: Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA) Initiative
articles.description: India, US, Japan, and Australia collaborate using commercial satellite data to track illegal fishing, maritime militia movements, and dark vessels across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.
articles.source: Ministry of External Affairs / Quad Joint Statement / GS2

articles.title: Jyotirao & Savitribai Phule: Pioneer of Anti-Caste and Girls' Education
articles.description: Establishing India's first school for girls in Bhide Wada Pune in 1848 and founding the Satyashodhak Samaj, the Phules dismantled Brahmanical hegemony and championed widow remarriage.
articles.source: Ministry of Social Justice / National Archives / GS1

articles.title: Anti-Defection Law: Tenth Schedule Interpretation and Speaker Neutrality
articles.description: Examining Kihoto Hollohan and recent Maharashtra legislative verdicts on whether presiding officers must resolve disqualification petitions expeditiously and objectively.
articles.source: Supreme Court Records / Lok Sabha Secretariat / GS2

articles.title: National Critical Minerals Mission: Lithium, Cobalt, and Rare Earth Security
articles.description: Auctions of offshore and critical mineral blocks in J&K, Chhattisgarh, and Karnataka aim to secure raw materials for EV batteries, aerospace, and solar panels.
articles.source: Ministry of Mines / Geological Survey of India / GS3

articles.title: Plastic Waste Management Rules: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
articles.description: Banning single-use plastics and enforcing digital EPR certificates on brand owners and packaging importers to finance formal recycling and eliminate multi-layered plastic waste.
articles.source: MoEFCC / Central Pollution Control Board / GS3

articles.title: Public Duty vs Official Secrecy: Ethical Dilemmas Under the OSA 1923
articles.description: Case study analyzing how civil servants balance classified information restrictions under the colonial Official Secrets Act against moral duty to expose public health risks.

articles.title: National Unity Day: Sardar Patel and the Integration of 565 Princely States
articles.description: Employing statesmanship, Privy Purses, and resolute firmness in Junagadh and Hyderabad, Sardar Patel and VP Menon unified sovereign India into a single constitutional republic.
articles.source: Ministry of Home Affairs / National Archives / GS1

articles.title: Mission Karmayogi: Competency-Driven Civil Services Capacity Building
articles.description: Transitioning civil services from rules-based to roles-based performance, the iGOT Karmayogi digital platform delivers continuous online training in integrity and citizen-centric governance.

articles.title: Sovereign Green Bonds: Mobilizing Domestic Capital for Decarbonization
articles.description: The Ministry of Finance issues rupee-denominated sovereign green bonds (SGrBs), using greenium yields to fund grid-scale solar, transmission lines, and metro rail networks.
articles.source: Ministry of Finance / Reserve Bank of India / GS3

articles.title: Project Dolphin: Conserving Gangetic and Indus River Dolphins
articles.description: Protecting endangered blind freshwater dolphins as apex river health indicators through acoustic monitoring, anti-poaching patrols, and sustainable non-destructive fishing nets.
articles.source: MoEFCC / Wildlife Institute of India / GS3

articles.title: Cybersecurity Threat Vectors: CERT-In Directives and Critical Infrastructure
articles.description: Mandating 6-hour incident reporting, CERT-In bolsters national cyber-defense across power grids, financial switches, and telecom nodes against advanced persistent threat (APT) groups.

articles.title: Linguistic Reorganisation of States: Fazal Ali Commission of 1953
articles.description: Following Potti Sreeramulu's hunger strike, the States Reorganisation Act 1956 harmonized linguistic aspirations with administrative unity, cementing democratic federalism.
articles.source: Ministry of Home Affairs / National Archives / GS1

articles.title: Social Audit Under MGNREGA: Institutionalizing Citizen Oversight
articles.description: Empowering Gram Sabhas to independently scrutinize muster rolls, work completion certificates, and wage disbursals, eliminating ghost beneficiaries and contractor collusion.
articles.source: Ministry of Rural Development / CAG / GS2

articles.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Modernizing India's Marine Fisheries
articles.description: With ₹20,050 crore outlay, PMMSY finances deep-sea fishing vessels, biofloc ponds, cold chain logistics, and sea-cage farming, transforming India into the #2 aquaculture producer.

articles.title: Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment): Sustainable Living Framework
articles.description: Championed at COP26, Mission LiFE mobilizes 1 billion people toward individual behavioral nudges—energy conservation, circular waste, and chemical-free diets—to curb carbon footprints.

articles.title: India-Africa Forum Summit: Historic Induction of African Union into G20
articles.description: Spearheaded by India at the New Delhi G20 Summit, the African Union's permanent membership anchors Global South representation across international economic rulemaking.

articles.title: Raja Ram Mohan Roy and the Bengal Renaissance: Abolition of Sati 1829
articles.description: Fusing Upanishadic monotheism with Western rationalism, Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj, championing free press, women's property rights, and the Sati Regulation XVII.
articles.source: Ministry of Culture / National Archives / GS1

articles.title: RTI Act and Section 8 Exemptions: Judicial Discourse on Public Interest
articles.description: Examining judicial thresholds where the public interest in disclosure outweighs privacy or state secrecy exemptions, safeguarding citizens' right to inspect government decisions.

articles.title: Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFCs): Slashing Heavy Rail Transit Times
articles.description: Eastern and Western DFCs segregate heavy freight trains from passenger lines, enabling 100 km/h double-stack container trains and slashing logistics transit time by 50%.

articles.title: International Solar Alliance (ISA): One Sun, One World, One Grid
articles.description: Headquartered in Gurugram with 120+ member nations, ISA unlocks concessional solar finance and envisions cross-border transmission grids sharing clean solar power across time zones.

articles.title: Moral Courage and Integrity: Resisting Unethical Executive Orders
articles.description: Case study analyzing civil servants who exercised constitutional conscience and moral courage to uphold procurement guidelines and reject illegal patronage directives.

articles.title: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and the Azad Hind Fauj: Military Diplomacy
articles.description: Forming the Provisional Government of Azad Hind in Singapore in 1943, Netaji mobilized the INA, Rani of Jhansi Regiment, and international diplomacy to challenge British colonial rule.
articles.source: National Archives of India / Ministry of Culture / GS1

articles.title: National Medical Commission (NMC): Reforming Healthcare Education Standards
articles.description: Replacing the Medical Council of India, the NMC enforces the National Exit Test (NExT), standardized fee regulations, and accreditation to bridge rural specialist doctor deficits.
articles.source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NMC / GS2

articles.title: PM Fasal Bima Yojana: Drone and Satellite Crop Loss Verification
articles.description: Integrating YES-TECH yield estimation and WINDS weather stations, PMFBY replaced manual crop cutting experiments with satellite remote-sensing for transparent claim payouts.

articles.title: Indian Antarctic and Arctic Programme: Maitri, Bharati, and Himadri
articles.description: Enacting the Indian Antarctic Act 2022, India conducts glaciology and deep ice-core drilling in polar stations to study past climatic fluctuations and sea-level rise.
articles.source: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research / MoES / GS3

articles.title: India-US Critical & Emerging Technology (iCET) Partnership
articles.description: Fostering strategic co-production in jet engines (GE F414), semiconductor supply chains, quantum research, and AI defense applications under the bilateral iCET framework.

articles.title: Constituent Assembly Debates: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and the Living Constitution
articles.description: Deliberating over 2 years 11 months and 18 days, the Assembly reconciled diverse views on fundamental rights, directive principles, and federal autonomy into a living document.
articles.source: Parliament of India / Law Ministry / GS1

articles.title: Good Governance Index (GGI): Benchmarking State and District Performance
articles.description: Assessing states across 10 sectors including agriculture, commerce, public infrastructure, and judiciary to foster competitive and cooperative federalism in service delivery.

articles.title: Harnessing India's Demographic Dividend: Skill India and Future of Work
articles.description: With a median age of 28, India coordinates the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and PMKVY 4.0 to upskill youth in Industry 4.0, green tech, and healthcare.
articles.source: Ministry of Skill Development / NITI Aayog / GS3

articles.title: India's Long-Term Low-Emission Strategy: Net Zero Target by 2070
articles.description: Submitted to UNFCCC, India's LT-LEDS outlines strategic pathways for deep electrification, industrial hydrogen adoption, carbon capture, and forest carbon sink expansion.

articles.title: Ethical Leadership in Disaster Management: 2004 Tsunami to Modern Preparedness
articles.description: Case study analyzing how ethical accountability and community mobilization led to the Disaster Management Act 2005, NDMA creation, and zero-casualty cyclone evacuations.
